answer: Equivocation-proof vine bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and posts one vine of work claims to an open atlas on a mesa registry. Each epoch, auditors re-run every vine; a vine branching into two clashing claims forfeits the bond, since one agent cannot do both jobs. First vine costs 45 credits, the k-th 45+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file one true vine and pay 45 once.
